payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each possible target value (first up to n/2 sorted elements), compute differences with later elements, generate divisors, and track divisor counts to find maximum k allowing at least half elements equal.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks all divisor candidates derived from pairwise differences, which is a complete search; labeled as branch-and-bound due to candidate set, though no explicit bounding is present.
